notes.title: Update
notes.content:
-Fixed some graphical bugs on asteroids
-Fixed glitched particle effect on singularity beam
-Sound effects now pause when the game pauses
-Score based achievements are now awarded correctly
-New sound effects for wave completion and miniraptors returning
-Laser kills achievement now works on any charged laser weapon

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: -Fixed teleporter/warp drive not working

notes.title: hotfix for tactical nuke bug
notes.content: -tactical nukes now wait until they reach their target before exploding

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
-Physics improvements for flamethrowers
-Updated explosions and particles to current unity system
-Prevented mouse from going off screen during gameplay
-Fixed username not being filled into the in game menu
-There is now an invisible save slot for your current build, no need to save to the first slot to keep it.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Missed posting a few changelogs, so this is likely to be incomplete (and will include some changes from earlier updates):

-Rumble can now be toggled
-Fixed bug which let players using a controller respawn without any lives in co op
-Updated unity
-Fixed a bug which made many smoke trails invisible
-Enemies which get too far from the player now get spun to face the player. The AI was properly trying to turn to face the player, but something was preventing their physics object from responding. This should prevent the endlessly retreating enemy bug.
-Buffed mortars, minimissiles and dumbfire ammo.
-Sniper enemies have lower muzzle velocity but higher projectile acceleration, which should make them easier to dodge at short range while still leaving them capable of sniping.
-A few enemies can turn a little faster.
-Music is now less compressed.
-Players using mouse&keyboard in splitscreen will no longer have their aim centered when certain controller inputs are made.

notes.title: Dedicated Servers + New Weapons
notes.content:
It's now possible to host a dedicated server. Setting up map rotation etc. is done by editing the DedicatedServer.txt file in the game folder. A standalone server (which won't require owning the base game) will be available soon.
Added new miniraptors secondary weapon. It launches tiny minions to destroy things for you. They can be equipped with chainguns, missile launchers or tesla coils. Unlock them by defeating the carrier (radioactive zone wave 10) or dreadnought (electron storm wave 5).
AI is now better at shooting/chasing moving targets.
Fixed some particle glitches for mac (probably)
Added a new bot which uses a shredder, hyperdisc and chaingun miniraptors.
MiniMissile primary weapon. Now you can spam missiles even when there's no ammo. It can be unlocked on Anomaly, Radioactive Zone or Electron Storm.
Added a heavy dummy to target practice mode.
Drill missiles now stick in things more reliably
Torpedoes now launch directly forwards.
Bombs and mines have bigger explosions.

notes.title: Bugfixes, graphical improvements and balance tweaks.
notes.content:
Added eye brightness slider to paint
2 New music tracks
Discs now explode if they hit the same enemy twice
Many enemies have better engine trails
Delete build buttons are now in the save menu instead of load
Bosses spawn further apart in multi boss fights
Fixed bug where getting hit by a giant laser would break postprocessing
Longer engine trails on player
Using menus with a controller has been sped up
A few enemy types are now better at flanking (they now approach diagonally unless they're behind you)
Small performance improvements when large numbers of enemies are on the map
Fixed some minor minimap glitches

notes.title: Nightmare mode + some new weapons.
notes.content:
New weapon: Shredder. It launches lots of bouncy discs.
New weapon: Hyperdisc. It launches a really big, laser guided bouncy disc.
(Both are dropped by the dreadnought on Electron Storm)
Added a nightmare difficulty which doubles all enemy spawns (including bosses). It has its own scoreboards.
Gyrojet howitzer and flak cannon now have better detonation control when aiming with a mouse.
Scattergun shoots more projectiles but has a bit more scatter.
Tweaked some enemy spawns, stats and AI.
Dreadnought now has a particle effect on its engines.
Some UI fixes.

notes.title: New Map: Electron Storm
notes.content:
Changelog:

New campaign map screen
New level: Electron Storm.
New enemy: Carrier. It has a railgun, chaingun and missile pod plus it launches smaller enemies.
New enemy: Plasma shogtunner. Explodes into a missile swarm when killed.
New enemy: Heavy Gunship. Shoots a lot of missiles.
New enemy: Spiral Demon. Teleports in and shoots a spiral of plasma bolts.
New Boss: Dreadnought. It's huge and has many weapons, including turrets which can be destroyed with well aimed fire.
New Boss: VoidRaptor. Now you can fight your giant evil clone, but be careful as it can steal powerups.
Improved AI on several enemies.
Killdozer now has a different turret.
Fixed background particles on very wide displays.
Fixed bug which allowed for infinite atomic thruster fuel.
Increased damage but reduced magazine capacity for many enemy chainguns.
Pickups now despawn the furthest rather than oldest in single player.
Terror Fortress now loads faster.
Tweaked how terror fortress takes damage.
Terror Fortress now fires lasers more often.
Added Shadows.
Added an invert aim Y option for controllers.

notes.title: New Deathmatch Map, lots of bugfixes.
notes.content:
New Deathmatch map: Barrels of Fun. It has explosive barrels.
Detonating an explosive barrel or mine near an enemy in PvP will now give credit.
Fixed a few weapons which weren't giving credit for PvP kills.

Fixed bug which prevented blaster combo kills from giving credit in PvP
Blaster fire rate (but not charge rate) increased.
Mortar trajectory indicator
Mortar shells now collide
Improved mortar trajectory algorighm + trail effect
Fixed bug which prevented the bear teleporter from locking onto players.
You can now see if someone is locking a bear teleporter onto you.
Spiral rune now works in multiplayer.
Fixed bug which was making the gatling beam less effective.
Camera moves ahead while using rocket boosters/hyperdrive so you can see where you're going.

Fixed a few bot AI glitches
Bots now zigzag when approaching from long range, making them harder to hit.
Fixed bug that let bots shoot invisible lasers.
Added some more bots.

notes.content:
The last patch broke the plasma thrusters, this build fixes that.

Bots collect health, ammo and coolant when they need it..

Bots now have offscreen position indicators in co op.
Teammates now have offscreen position indicators in TDM.
